WITH director_years AS (
    SELECT 
        d.name_id,
        m.year,
        LEAD(m.year, 1, NULL) OVER (PARTITION BY d.name_id ORDER BY m.year) as next_year
    FROM director_mapping d
    JOIN movies m ON d.movie_id = m.id
),
movie_gaps AS (
    SELECT 
        name_id,
        year,
        next_year,
        CASE WHEN next_year IS NOT NULL THEN next_year - year ELSE NULL END as gap
    FROM director_years
),
avg_gaps AS (
    SELECT 
        name_id,
        ROUND(AVG(gap), 0) as avg_inter_movie_duration
    FROM movie_gaps
    WHERE gap IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY name_id
),
director_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        d.name_id,
        n.name as director_name,
        COUNT(*) as movie_count,
        ROUND(AVG(r.avg_rating), 2) as avg_rating,
        SUM(r.total_votes) as total_votes,
        MIN(r.avg_rating) as min_rating,
        MAX(r.avg_rating) as max_rating,
        SUM(m.duration) as total_movie_duration
    FROM director_mapping d
    JOIN names n ON d.name_id = n.id
    JOIN movies m ON d.movie_id = m.id
    LEFT JOIN ratings r ON d.movie_id = r.movie_id
    GROUP BY d.name_id, n.name
)

```sql
WITH director_movies AS (
    SELECT 
        dm.name_id,
        n.name,
        m.id as movie_id,
        m.date_published,
        m.duration,
        r.avg_rating,
        r.total_votes
    FROM director_mapping dm
    JOIN names n ON dm.name_id = n.id
    JOIN movies m ON dm.movie_id = m.id
    JOIN ratings r ON dm.movie_id = r.movie_id
),
director_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        name_id,
        name,
        COUNT(*) as movie_count,
        SUM(duration) as total_movie_duration,
        AVG(avg_rating) as avg_rating,
        ROUND(AVG(avg_rating), 2) as avg_rating_rounded,
        MIN(avg_rating) as min_rating,
        MAX(avg_rating) as max_rating,
        SUM(total_votes) as total_votes
    FROM director_movies
    GROUP BY name_id, name
),
director_inter_duration AS (
    SELECT 
        name_id,
        ROUND(AVG(DATEDIFF('day', LAG(date_published) OVER (PARTITION BY name_id ORDER BY date_published), date_published))) as avg_inter_movie_duration
    FROM director_movies
    GROUP BY name_id
)
SELECT 
    ds.name_id,
    ds.name,
    ds.movie_count,
    di.avg_inter_movie_duration,
    ds.avg_rating_rounded,
    ds.total_votes,
    ds.min_rating,
    ds.max_rating,
    ds.total_movie_duration
FROM director_stats ds
JOIN director_inter_duration di ON ds.name_id = di.name_id
ORDER BY ds.movie_count DESC, ds.total_movie_duration DESC
LIMIT 9
```
